A '''[[Battlesphere/Legends|battlesphere]]''' was deployed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] in order to use its laser to recharge the long depleted power source of a an ancient [[Unidentified Mustafar superweapon|superweapon]] buried on the world.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" />

After learning of Grievious's plan to activate the superweapon, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] deployed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to the battlesphere to disrupt the sphere's three firing platforms before it could charge the weapon. The two teams were able to destroy the first two firing platforms, however when Skywalker and Tano reached the third they were confronted by EG-07. Though eventually defeated, EG-07 was able to delay the two Jedi long enough to allow the platform to fire and charge the weapon. Afterward Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] were deployed to the surface and were able to destroy the weapon's core.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battlesphere was first shown in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]], which was released in [[2009]].<ref name="Republic Heroes DS" />
